verdict.rationale: Bolna has its own AI post-call analysis. Call summaries can be switched on per agent, and extraction categories (name plus model) attach to an agent and pull structured data from every call. The evidence does not show AI that automatically scores call quality, flags failed calls or judges resolution; those would have to be built as custom extraction categories. Missing for 10: built-in AI quality scoring of calls, automatic failure flagging, resolution/outcome analysis, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the platform's AI reviews my calls for me — scoring quality, flagging failures, and analyzing resolution automatically

citations.quote: POST /agent/{agent_id}/extraction-categories — create a category (name + model) and attach it to an agent
Call summaries are an agent-level toggle: call_summary_enabled (boolean, off by default) on the agent create and update APIs
Configure webhooks, call summaries, and extractions for Bolna Voice AI. Push data to your CRM from every call.
